column1: # settings.tsv — devseed settings, tab-separated key/value rows.
# format.version MUST stay the first row; its syntax never changes so any
# engine version can read it and refuse cleanly (see vision.md).
# brew.dump_categories: extra `brew bundle dump` categories beyond
# Absent/commented = all off (see vision.md ADR-5 for why vscode is opt-in).
# To enable, add a row like:  brew.dump_categories<TAB>vscode
